title: After a batch merge, merge --confirm prints the idle-lanes report, or says the pass is owed
why: Runner 10 has never run the archive pass after a merge (decision session-tiers, archiving lanes), because it had no live file. The pass rests on the runner remembering a second command.
note: After a successful batch merge, merge --confirm reads the live file from origin/roadmap:roadmap/live/live.json. If its readAt is after the merge base's time, it prints the --idle-lanes report; if not, it prints one line saying the pass is owed and the file is stale. Red test first. Sibling of step batch-runner-start-names-idle-lanes (doing), which only names the command in the start text. Triage commits the live file at that path at each batch merge (from 00:44 CST Nov 13). Coordinator 00:52 CST Nov 13: runner 10's first --idle-lanes pass archived lane scratchpad-file-ownership (session_013NEJL29GcaaeoS7a1SJYA2), which the owner had unarchived himself; the coordinator unarchived it. The pass needs a keep list: sessions the owner unarchived or marked KEEP. Triage added `keepSessions` [{id, reason}] to roadmap/live/live.json (that lane, and L2NQu1Fvby2aRtj353 for items 632/633); --idle-lanes must skip them. Red test first. Unmeasured: whether the owner's unarchive is readable from list_sessions, which would make the list automatic.
